coordinates: per hand: landmarks minus the wrist, in pixels (x * width, y * height, z * width), divided by the 2D wrist to middle-finger MCP (landmark 9) length; a hand whose length is ~0 is absent; then the 13 values of preprocessing.face
interpolation: linear coordinates, nearest binary flags, absent coordinates zeroed

sign_window.rule: training clips are cut to the frames with a hand (plus the margin), then resampled to 32 frames

extraction.image_orientation: unmirrored camera frames; only the preview is mirrored

handedness.rule: trained on right-dominant signing; a left-handed signer's frames are mirrored first

face.values: per hand (Left, then Right): wrist, thumb tip and index tip as (x, y) minus the nose (face landmark 1), x multiplied by width / height first, divided by the 2D forehead (10) to chin (152) length; then the face flag. A hand that is absent (or whose palm length is ~0), or a frame without a face, gives zeros
face.interpolation: a hand's location values linear only when the hand and the face are in both frames, else from the nearest frame; the face flag from the nearest frame
face.mirror: a left-handed signer: location x negated, Left and Right location swapped, the face flag stays
